title: Gimbal object is a distant jet

tellings.quote: my hypothesis is that it's a distant jet.

plain: The object in the Gimbal video, a 2015 US Navy infrared recording from a fighter jet off Florida that seems to show a craft hovering and rotating, is "a distant jet," according to Mick West, a well-known skeptic who analyses UFO footage. West lays out this hypothesis in a debate on the show, where the video is tied to the Navy pilot Ryan Graves; if he is right, one of the most famous military UFO videos shows an ordinary airplane.
